label: Stonehenge, 1:12 acoustic scale model (University of Salford)
note: model of the stone circle about 2200 BC with 157 stones, open to the sky; conditions: 2200BC model (complete) and four partial configurations named by the stone groups present (InnerTrilithonHorseshoe, +OuterSarsenCircleUprights, +OuterSarsenCircleLintels, +OuterBluestoneCircle); each IR holds six octave bands, 125 Hz-4 kHz, with the levels restored from gains.txt; valid up to about 5.5 kHz, test loudspeaker response not removed, tails below the noise floor replaced by modelled noise and air absorption corrected to full scale (readme); receiver positions m2 and m8 are the same
